qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strong cellular standard essential patent portfolio and optical network tech, but core Mobile Networks faces commoditized pricing, customer concentration, and intense competition from Ericsson.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power). While Nokia possesses high-quality patent licensing and optical transport assets, its core Mobile Networks division suffers from chronic sub-12% multi-cycle ROIC, commoditized pricing pressure, and customer vulnerability as evidenced by losing AT&T's multi-billion dollar RAN contract to Ericsson.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC consistently below the 12% threshold (hovering in mid-single digits). Continuous restructuring charges, price deflation in mobile RAN hardware, and customer concentration risk (loss of AT&T footprint).
